bio: THE FRAMES ARE A DUBLIN ROCK BAND WITH A RARE GIFT FOR MAKING BIG ROOMS FEEL INTIMATE. LED BY GLEN HANSARD, THEY’VE SPENT DECADES BLENDING INDIE ROCK, FOLK AND SWELLING, EMOTIONAL SONGWRITING INTO MUSIC THAT CAN START AS A WHISPER AND END IN A FULL-BLOWN SINGALONG. WARM, RAW AND DEEPLY HUMAN, THE FRAMES HAVE BUILT A DEVOTED FOLLOWING ON SONGS THAT FEEL LIVED-IN AND LIVE SHOWS THAT STICK WITH YOU LONG AFTER THE LAST NOTE.
